query:
*[_type == "ticketType" && slug.current == $slug && active == true][0]{
    _id,
    name,
    "slug": slug.current,
    demo,
    active,
    price,
    regularPrice,
    description,
    capacity,
    show,
    releasedQuantity,
    earlyBirdCutoff,
    requiresDaySelection,
    requiresAttendeeNames,
    provisional,
    category,
    capacityPool,
    headcountPerUnit,
    excludedDays
  }

result.description: Test data — never real pricing. Used to exercise the ticketing pipeline end-to-end in isolation from the real show. Never active except for a brief, human-supervised test window.
result.name: General Admission (Fictional Test Show)
